from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPS(BaseModel):
    """Basic earnings per share data for a single company from a 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the 10-Q filing")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share value for the period; losses are negative")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this EPS value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_data: list[CompanyEPS]
